name: The Keys
blurb: One road, too many bridges, and a deputy who has seen everything twice.

meta.notes: M1 stub; the traffic lane owns this file in M1. The mix weights equal the sim's per-category defaults (car 5, truck 2), because SimConfig does not carry the mix yet: see the traffic-1 changes note. For the same reason the pedestrian and animal weights are all 1, which is how sim/peds picks them (evenly within a list; a `pedestrians` roadside zone gets the odd stray animal): see the traffic-2 changes note.
